notes:
CRM notes (summary + timeline):
- Account intro: Lotus Harbor Systems — mid-market SaaS (product analytics). CTO + Head of ML evaluating LLM features to add in-product assistant and document search.
- Initial interest: started with Hosted API for quick proof of concept (POC) to validate quality + latency; after positive POC they want Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- Key business drivers: improve self-serve support deflection, speed up onboarding walkthroughs, provide contextual suggestions in product UI. Target ARR impact ~0.5-1% initially; long-term product stickiness uplift.
- Timeline & recent activity:
  * 2026-02-05: Intro demo (hosted) — 45m demo of chat + embeddings. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-05-demo. AE: Avery Chen. SE: Rajan attended.
  * 2026-02-12: Hosted POC kickoff (3-week) — integration using Redwood hosted endpoints for search reranking + chat. Provided quickstart repo + sample prompts.
  * 2026-02-20: POC check-in — latency looks good for sample traffic; engineering asked for 95th pctl metrics and token cost estimate. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-20-lotus-poc.
  * 2026-02-25: Pricing intro call — discussed 12-month Dedicated commitment with burst capacity; AE shared draft pricing deck (drive:/Sales/LOTUS/Redwood-POC-pricing-v2.pdf).
  * 2026-03-03: Security deep-dive with infra + legal; went through SOC2 matrix and SSO/SAML flows. Fireflies: ff_2026-03-03-security-call.
  * 2026-03-04: Internal security questionnaire submitted by Lotus; Redwood responded with itemized answers (drive:/Security/LOTUS/security-questions-responses.xlsx). Linked ticket SEC-5178 opened for encryption/KMS questions.
- Technical / requirements summary:
  * Workloads: primary chat assistant (real-time), secondary doc-search/reranking (batch + nearline).
  * Traffic profile (expected once GA): avg 15K token-requests/day, peak ~8-12k requests/hour; peak concurrency ~120 RPS during feature launches.
  * Latency SLO: p95 generation < 400ms for short chats (<=256 tokens); acceptable fallback to quantized variants for heavier loads.
  * Throughput: need predictable sustained throughput for scheduled feature releases; prefer Dedicated with reserved GPU pools + burst reserve.
  * Cost sensitivity: mid, prioritize predictable unit economics over lowest spot price. Looking for batching/caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
  * Model preferences: open/Redwood-verified models (quantized 7B/13B variants for cost/latency tradeoffs). Want automatic fallback to smaller variant on capacity constraints.
- Security & compliance specifics (Focus of current procurement):
  * SOC2: require SOC2 Type II evidence and a mapping of Redwood controls to Lotus requirements.
  * SSO/SAML: must integrate with Okta; IdP-initiated SSO and SCIM provisioning a must.
  * Audit logging: need token-level request logs (metadata) retained for 90 days; sensitive payloads must not be stored in plaintext in shared logs.
  * Retention controls: retention controls configurable per-route with customer override.
  * KMS: require customer-managed keys (CMKs) / HSM option for encryption at rest; ensure key rotation policies documented.
  * Network: VPC peering or PrivateLink to avoid egress over public internet; expect to provide networking diagram and CIDR ranges (blocker).
  * Data residency: primary requirement us-east region; need confirmation Dedicated can be colocated.
  * E-discovery/legal holds: legal would like ability to freeze retention policies for investigation.
- Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "We want the performance and no-surprises operational costs, but security is the gating factor. If you can show SOC2 + KMS + VPC peering, we can move to commitment."
- POC notes & success criteria:
  * POC objectives: validate p95 latency under synthetic peak, validate embeddings accuracy for doc search, validate end-to-end SSO flow with minimal changes.
  * Metrics to accept POC: p95 latency < 400ms under 75% of predicted traffic, embedding recall >= 88% on internal test set, successful SSO+SCIM end-to-end test.
  * POC timeframe: 3 weeks hosted -> if passes then move to Dedicated pilot (1-2 weeks) with reduced commit.
- Pricing & commercial status:
  * AE provided 12-month reserved pricing + burst clause; Lotus asked for a smaller pilot-first pricing option to reduce procurement friction.
  * Estimated ARR if committed: 75k-200k (see estimated_arr_range).
- Action items / next steps (owner in parentheses):
  * Provide SOC2 Type II report + control mapping (Redwood security) — urgent.
  * Deliver VPC peering runbook & network diagram template (SE: Rajan).
  * Finalize dedicated pricing addendum and send to procurement (AE: Avery).
  * Set up pilot Dedicated cluster for 2-week test if SOC2 evidence OK (Infra/Onboarding team).
- Blockers (reiterated): SOC2 evidence needed for legal sign-off; Lotus infra needs networking CIDR and peering details; internal budget approval for committed capacity still pending.
- Internal notes for Redwood: prioritize security packet delivery; offer pilot pricing and a 60-day rollback clause; highlight Optimize suggestions for caching to reduce committed GPU size.
- Communication cadence: weekly syncs while POC active (Thursdays 11am PT).
public_notes: Evaluation focused on Hosted->Dedicated path. Prioritize SOC2, SSO/Okta, VPC peering and KMS. POC passed initial quality checks; security evidence is gating legal sign-off.
